name: myLen_replicate
prelude:
def myLen : List α → Nat
  | [] => 0
  | _ :: xs => myLen xs + 1
statement: theorem myLen_replicate (n : Nat) (a : α) : myLen (List.replicate n a) = n
proofs:
induction n with
  | zero => rfl
  | succ n ih => simp [List.replicate, myLen, ih]
  have h : ∀ ys : List α, myLen ys = ys.length := by
    intro ys
    induction ys with
    | nil => rfl
    | cons y ys ih => rw [myLen, ih, List.length_cons]
  rw [h, List.length_replicate]
